events.summary: Brian Tanaka, 2026-09-02: Baycrest Connectors is now BCX Interconnect - 2027 quotation BCX-Q-2609 (quote, review)

Baycrest Connectors (SUP-0016) sent quotation BCX-Q-2609 for 11 parts (including HR-20103 and HR-20104) with a 2027 price set, valid to 30 November 2026. It also asks that purchase orders go to a new BCX Interconnect address, and says the bank details and terms are unchanged. The sender, Brian Tanaka, writes from an address that is not the contact on file, so the message needs review and nothing should be sent to the new address until the contact on file confirms it.

**Baycrest Connectors / BCX Interconnect: quotation BCX-Q-2609 (Brian Tanaka, 2 September 2026)**

**What it is.** A 2027 price quote for 11 parts, sent under the notice that Baycrest Connectors is now BCX Interconnect. The quote is for HR-20103, HR-20104, HR-20110, HR-20111 and others. The prices, stated in the message and read as extracted, are:
- Items 1 to 6 are priced per thousand, converted to each: 0.2406, 0.2854, 0.1147, 0.1399, 0.01921 and 1.537 USD.
- Items 7 to 11 are priced each: 9.10, 13.24, 4.14, 7.25 and 11.90 USD.
- All are valid to 30 November 2026.
- The quote says origin is shown by line, but the origin values were not in what I could read. Dongguan-built items may be affected by a pending tariff action, so origin needs checking before these prices are compared.

**What it changes.** Nothing on an open PO line. It adds a quote with a validity date of 30 November 2026. The message also changes the ordering address: it asks that purchase orders go to orders@bcxinterconnect.example, with the old baycrestconnectors.example addresses forwarding until 31 December 2026. It says the tax ID, bank account, remit-to address, payment terms (Net 30) and delivery terms (DDP Reno) are unchanged. It also says Tijuana production for the charging contacts is targeted for Q2 2027.

**Is the sender who they claim?** Not verified. Brian Tanaka writes from an address that is not the contact on file for SUP-0016, so the message is marked for review. Nothing should go to the new address on the strength of this email. The supplier's own contact on file is the only address for orders and any reply.

**Is the rename real?** The supplier master supports it. Baycrest Connectors, Inc. (SUP-0016) is the company, and the record "BCX Interconnect" (SUP-0061) is already linked to it as stated, so it is one company and there is nothing to propose. A second record, V10045 "Baycrest Connectors Inc", is linked by inferred domain match. No separate BCX company exists. The change of name itself is consistent with the master, but the acquisition and the new ordering address are only claims in the email.

**Thread.** This is a single message with no corrections or follow-ups.

**Recommended next step.** Priya Nair should check the new address and the Dongguan origin claims with the contact on file before approving any PO change, and before comparing these prices. The 30 November validity date should be on the calendar.
